body:
## What it does

First it pins down the role you are actually going for and the facts on your CV it is allowed to use. After that it works a steady weekday rhythm: applications written for the specific posting, plus warm referral messages to people already inside the company. It runs on a schedule rather than waiting to be asked.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @joshkim shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
